decision_cruda.rationale: LH-03 repair is in place, likely 09:54 (high 10:00), radio and CMMS agree. After the repair LH-03 alone loads about 235 t of the 307 t left at E543-07 by 17:00 (35.6 t/h, with the lunch break). Este has spare truck capacity (24 of 72 t/h in) and the stockpile is at 93 of 450 t. LH-08 is on the infrastructure heading, which is worth 0.4 oz/h, and is 0.33 h away. Lending it adds about 72 t at 8.3 g/t, roughly 19 oz, against about 3 oz of development lost. The critical-path loader LH-09 stays put. I did not move other loaders: Norte and Central are either truck-limited or have no spare loader.

LH-03 is down until 14:30-17:30 (likely 15:30), and radio and CMMS agree. LH-08 stays on E543-07 (8.3 g/t, 294 t). Its home heading is worth only 0.4 oz/h. LH-08 alone mucks about 165 t by 17:00. LH-10 is idle at the workshop and available now, with a 0.49 h trip. It adds about 129 t, or about 34 oz. Este trucks (72 t/h) and stockpile (81 of 450 t) have room. Central's stockpile is truck-limited, so I added no loader there. No reserve can be activated because no stope is stopped.
